name: success_coach
style_suffix: cinematic photoreal modern documentary look, contemporary 2026 setting, soft natural directional light, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, slightly desaturated muted palette, 35mm cinematic feel, calm and observational
default_music_prompt: Calm reflective acoustic underscore for a professional development documentary. Soft warm piano, subtle string pads, restrained and hopeful but not saccharine. Light, considered, room for a narrator. No percussion, no obvious melody, slow build of thoughtfulness. Modern documentary tone.

base_canon.coach_avatar: Coach Alex, a friendly approachable man in his mid-forties with a kind face that radiates genuine warmth (an ordinary likeable face, NOT polished, NOT symmetrically perfect, NOT the manicured handsome look of a fashion model or LinkedIn-influencer headshot), very fair skin with a light natural tan, very short closely-cropped dark brown hair worn almost buzzed on the sides and only slightly longer but still very short on top with natural texture (no styled part, no fringe, slightly receding at the temples as a real man's hair in his forties), clean-shaven, clear bright blue eyes that crinkle warmly at the corners with subtle crow's-feet, medium dark eyebrows, an oval friendly face with broader friendly jaw (defined but NOT chiselled, NOT model-sculpted), slightly rounded cheeks when he smiles, a wide open genuinely joyful smile that fully shows the upper teeth (this is the most important feature — NOT a closed-mouth half-smile, NOT a smirk, NOT a polished closed expression, but the full open warm smile of someone genuinely glad to be talking to you), head level and slightly forward-leaning toward the viewer (NEVER chin-up, NEVER head tilted back, NEVER the haughty pose of a portrait subject), natural lived-in skin texture with slight asymmetry, the visible warmth of an experienced coach who actually likes his work and the people he works with, lean athletic build visible in the shoulders, wearing a dark navy quarter-zip merino knit jumper with a small visible metal zip pull at the collar, the collar of a softer pale blue collared shirt visible underneath the open zip, no tie, no blazer, the smart-casual look of a trusted coach in his home study, photoreal painterly cinematic 2026
base_canon.coach_office: warm cinematic home study, behind him a densely packed wooden bookshelf running floor-to-ceiling on the back wall with real books of varied spines and natural disorder, a few small framed family photographs deliberately out of focus enough not to be identifiable, two small framed professional awards leaning casually against books rather than mounted formally, a small antique brass desk clock on one shelf as a signature element, a single warm practical desk lamp visible creating a pool of warm light, warm brown and amber wood tones balanced by cool navy of his jumper, late afternoon warm-light feel, photoreal painterly cinematic contemporary 2026 home study setting

thumbnail.candidate_prompt_suffix: one strong cinematic focal subject in the right two-thirds (a lone faceless silhouette seen from behind, an empty modern office at dusk, or a single symbolic object), moody dramatic lighting, restrained desaturated palette with one warm accent light, the left third kept dark and low-detail for the headline, no visible faces, no text, photoreal, sixteen by nine
thumbnail.selection_rules: Pick the candidate with the cleanest dark left-third negative space where the headline lands, the single strongest readable subject at a glance, no garbled faces or text artifacts, nothing bleeding into the headline column. Premium and intriguing, never cheap stock-slop, pointing fingers, or shock-face.
